Bit is a tool for managing components in your project. It allows you to add, tag, export, and import components, and track their status.

## Usage

### Initialize Bit

To initialize Bit in your project, run the following command:

```bash
bit init
```

This will create a `workspace.json` file in your project.

### Add Components

To add a component to your project, run the following command:

```bash
bit add <path/to/component>
```

This will add the component to your project and update the `workspace.json` file.

### Tag Components

To tag a component with a version number, run the following command:

```bash
bit tag <component-name> <version>
```

This will tag the component with the specified version number.

### Export Components

To export a component, run the following command:

```bash
bit export <component-name>
```

This will make the component available for other team members or projects to import.

### Import Components

To import a component, run the following command:

```bash
bit import <path/to/component>
```

This will import the component into your project.
